entities.name: PMID:27515802
observations: Pradeilles et al. (2016) assessed readiness among 51 religious leaders in Johannesburg and Soweto using the Community Readiness Model and focus groups.
The study reports an overall readiness score of 2.57 ± 0.76, classified as denial/resistance; dimension scores were lowest for knowledge of efforts (1.77 ± 1.50) and community climate (2.00 ± 0.64).

entities.name: Urban South Africa readiness
observations: In this case study, readiness for adolescent overweight/obesity prevention among religious leaders in Johannesburg and Soweto was low: mean Community Readiness Model score 2.57 ± 0.76, corresponding to denial/resistance.
Focus groups found leaders recognized a potential health role, but limited awareness of existing efforts and negative community attitudes indicated awareness-building was needed before intervention.
